text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Wah-wah-wah, there are so many people in 
the stands...!! The Hopeful Stakes is 
finally here...!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Still, I've trained so much, so I'll 
definitely be okaaay...!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Today, I'll get completely used to longer 
races, and connect this to the Derby...!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
All riiiight! I'm gonna give it everything 
I've gottt!!
